title: Mrs. Glasner's apology and her help with recording contacts
summary: Glasner apologised with refreshments, became his best friend, brought recording executives and top bandleaders to hear him, and he won a renewed contract within fifteen days.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: So, when we finished our rehearsals, we were about to leave to go home, -- the name of this person was Mrs. Ellie Glasner, and she was an M.C., Master of Ceremonies, Hostess, you know.

She presented the attractions, and she did an attraction herself. And as we finished the rehearsals, the waiter came up to us and said, 'You go over to the bar. Something's waiting for you at the bar.'
So, we went over to the bar, and there was a table set with coffee, tea or whatever you wanted, pastries and everything else. So we said, 'In Madam's honor.'

So she came up and she said, 'I'm awfully sorry, I hope you'll excuse me,' she said. She said, 'I haven't been very polite,' she said, 'But I hope you'll excuse me, because after all, the last war and everything else, and that had never happened before, we had never had a colored man in the Barbarina since I've been here, and I'm awfully sorry, but I'm trying
to make up, because I offer you this." "And I offer you this, you shall have this every day in your intermission." It happened.
And that person, Mrs. Glasner, she became my best friend, and I'd run an orchestra and everything, she was the one that helped me to get my recordings and everything.
She went and invited the managing directors of the different recording companies to come and listen to the orchestra.
She also invited all of the top band leaders, like Marek Weber, and Darius Bela, Ephaim Schachtmeister, and who else?
Oh, yes, Norbert Fraconi. And she had them all to come to the Barbarina and listen to the orchestra and everything. So, she really sent the orchestra.
And after three months, within fifteen days, I had an option for another three months. Within fifteen days, I had an option.
Because the people, they were satisfied, we played good music.
